# Each row is `source; expected`: the toAsciiN column, or `!` where the
# toAsciiN status has a code other than A4_1, A4_2, U1, V2, V3, X4_2,
# which are the checks the URL Standard turns off or that only concern toUnicode.
# Escapes are \uXXXX and \x{XXXX} as in the original.
#
# A row is kept when
# - the source is not empty, has no forbidden host code point and no lone surrogate
# - the source is not plain ASCII without an `xn--` label, which a URL host only lowercases
# - an expected result is not empty, has no forbidden domain code point and
#   does not end in a number, which a URL host reads as an IPv4 address
